question: Were you married at the end of last year, and does anyone live with you that you support?
why_ask: Filing status sets the standard deduction, tax rates and filing threshold.
retrieval_query: how to choose filing status single head of household

question: Did you live in California for all of last year?
why_ask: Full-year residents file Form 540; part-year residents and nonresidents file Form 540NR.

question: What is the total in Box 1 of all your W-2 forms?
why_ask: Income level decides how much rental loss can be deducted against wages.

question: Do you own a house, condo or room that you rented out last year?
why_ask: Rental income and expenses are reported on Schedule E.
retrieval_query: rental income and expenses Schedule E

question: Is the rental property in California?
why_ask: Property in another state is taxed by that state too.
retrieval_query: nonresident rental income other state California credit

question: How much rent did you receive in total?
why_ask: All rent received, including advance rent, is income in the year received.
retrieval_query: rental income advance rent security deposit

question: About how much did you spend on the rental (mortgage interest, property tax, insurance, repairs, management)?
why_ask: Ordinary rental expenses reduce rental income; repairs and improvements are treated differently.

question: Did you start renting this property for the first time last year?
why_ask: Depreciation starts when the property is placed in service; the purchase records set the basis.
retrieval_query: depreciation of rental property placed in service 27.5 years

question: Did you or your family stay there yourselves for more than 14 days, or more than 10% of the days it was rented?
why_ask: Personal use above that limit makes it a vacation home and limits deductions.
retrieval_query: personal use of dwelling unit 14 days 10 percent

question: Were most guests' stays a week or shorter, for example through Airbnb?
why_ask: Very short average stays change how the activity is treated.
retrieval_query: short term rental average period of customer use 7 days passive

question: Did you sell the property last year?
why_ask: A sale must report gain or loss and recapture depreciation taken.
retrieval_query: sale of rental property depreciation recapture
